summary: First-finish smoke testing for Kabul Star Academy Phase 1. Backend auth, announcements CRUD, contact settings, dashboards, and role guards work correctly. Frontend homepage loads with hero/announcements/CTAs, manager login redirects to /dashboard/manager (shell + sidebar + module cards), protected-route redirect works, and logout returns user to /login/manager. Only issue found: the login lockout (5 failed attempts -> 429) is not being enforced by the backend.
passed: POST /api/auth/login manager (200) sets access_token + refresh_token httpOnly cookies (Secure, SameSite=None, Partitioned)
GET /api/auth/me with cookie returns manager user
Role mismatch (student creds + role=manager) returns 403 with 'not a manager' message
POST /api/announcements without auth 401; with teacher 403; with manager 200
PATCH and DELETE /api/announcements/{id} as manager return 200
GET /api/settings/contact returns merged defaults (academy_name, slogan, motto, phone, etc.)
GET /api/dashboard/manager as manager returns 200 with stats+modules; as teacher returns 403
POST /api/auth/refresh with refresh_token cookie returns 200 and new access_token
POST /api/auth/logout returns 200 and sets Set-Cookie headers to clear both tokens (Max-Age=0)
Demo teacher login works with role=teacher
Frontend homepage loads with hero CTA, three role login buttons, nav login menu, and announcements section
Manager login via UI (email + password + submit) redirects to /dashboard/manager and renders dashboard-manager-root with sidebar and module cards
Sidebar logout returns user to /login/manager (session cleared)

failed.issue: Login lockout is not enforced. After 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts against teacher@kabulstar.edu (a real user), backend continues returning 401 instead of 429, and the account is not locked (correct password immediately after still succeeds with 200). Same behavior for unknown emails.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/auth/login with wrong password x6 -> all 401 (never 429). 7th attempt with correct password -> 200 with token.

action_items: Investigate lockout logic in /app/backend/server.py login endpoint (~line 157): login_attempts counter/threshold is not triggering 429 after 5 failures within the 15-min window. Verify identifier key, counter persistence in Mongo, and the 429 branch.
notes: Logout cookie clearing verified via response Set-Cookie headers (Max-Age=0, empty value) — curl's cookie jar doesn't overwrite pre-saved entries so a follow-up /me via curl still appears authenticated, but this is a curl artifact, not a backend bug. Browsers (and the UI flow) correctly clear the session, verified by UI logout redirect. Test credentials file /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present.
